claims.claim: MongoDB announced on September 28 that CEO Chirantan 'CJ' Desai stepped down and founder/former CEO Dev Ittycheria became interim CEO one day before Investor Day; this is a new governance/execution uncertainty that Alpha can source-address separately from operating momentum.

risks.risk: An abrupt CEO transition immediately before a major investor communication can increase near-term strategy, execution and leadership-continuity uncertainty even when underlying product demand remains intact.

falsifiers: Clear permanent leadership succession, unchanged or improved operating guidance, and evidence of continued customer/Atlas execution would reduce the materiality of this governance risk.

unknowns.unknown: The transition's cause, permanent succession timing and any effect on product or go-to-market execution are not established by the announcement alone.
